scope: Same-machine optimized candidate rerun: five repetitions and 50 sort requests per profile. Accepted phases are quiet-debug-03 and quiet-release-02; no compiler or identified build-launcher process observed during their runner windows. Earlier attempts are preserved separately and excluded from the accepted comparison. Historical baseline/candidate rows had concurrent builds, so comparisons are directional and not a new build-free baseline/candidate A/B.
